variationScope: Only globally common difficultyStepMultiplier varied in private worker memory. BaseHealthScale stayed 1.12, production files and the shared AI action policy were not edited; candidate parameters were identical across resource masks.

recommendation.basis: Neither requested fresh candidate passed every sampled D6/D4 point target. No further sweep or production change was performed.

limitations: All samples in this artifact are development samples. No prior formal release outcome was pooled into calibration metrics.
D10 was not resampled: the step exponent is zero at D10, so this parameter does not affect D10 enemy HP.
Only S1.235 has D8 development observations in this artifact. S1.22 and S1.23 require D8 validation on a fresh independent release seed before acceptance.
Confidence intervals quantify uncertainty; overlap with the target band does not turn an out-of-band point estimate into a pass.
Defense planners remain enabled throughout. Actual consumed/generated defense totals and per-game strata are reported separately; these samples do not prove a missing-defense mapping.
The low/effective defense observation thresholds 20%/50% are provisional reporting choices, not a permanent user specification or an AI reward.
Shared seeds pair candidates within a batch. Different development batches use distinct seeds and their rates must not be treated as paired comparisons.

batches.rulesPolicy: Only globally common baseHealthScale and difficultyStepMultiplier vary by candidate, never by resource mask within a candidate.
batches.jointOutcomeInterpretation: Observed consumption strata are descriptive, not randomized absence of natural defense.
